item.text: {"action":"write","arguments_json":"{\"path\":\"work.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Evaluate whether declared source dependencies have changed.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\nimport json\\n\\n_MISSING = {\\\"kind\\\": \\\"missing\\\"}\\n\\ndef _canonical(state):\\n    return json.dumps(state, sort_keys=True, separators=(\\\",\\\", \\\":\\\"))\\n\\ndef evaluate(request, policy):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compare complete saved/current states for relevant declared paths.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    ignored = set(policy.get(\\\"ignored\\\", ()))\\n    saved = request.get(\\\"saved\\\", {})\\n    current = request.get(\\\"current\\\", {})\\n    changed = sorted({\\n        path\\n        for path in request.get(\\\"declared\\\", ())\\n        if path not in ignored\\n        and _canonical(saved.get(path, _MISSING)) != _canonical(current.get(path, _MISSING))\\n    })\\n    return {\\\"needs_review\\\": bool(changed), \\\"changed\\\": changed}\\n\"}"}
